'''Red Shuttle''' was a [[Beta-class assault shuttle|''Beta-''class assault shuttle]] made by [[Telgorn Corporation/Legends|Telgorn Corporation]] and stationed aboard the ''[[Eye of Palpatine]]''. In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], [[Nichos Marr/Legends|Nichos Marr]] operated the shuttle via remote control in order to evacuate the inhabitants of the ''Eye''.
